senses.sense_definition: A large room or building equipped for indoor sports, exercise, and physical training.

examples.text: The students gathered in the school <w>gymnasium</w> for the morning assembly.
Our new sports center includes a modern <w>gymnasium</w> with weightlifting equipment.

senses.sense_definition: A type of secondary school in various European countries that prepares students for university education.

examples.text: After completing primary school, she was accepted into a prestigious local <w>gymnasium</w>.
He taught mathematics at a German <w>gymnasium</w> before moving abroad.

senses.sense_definition: In ancient Greece, a public place or building used for physical exercise, training, and philosophical discussion.

examples.text: Young citizens gathered at the ancient <w>gymnasium</w> to practice wrestling and listen to philosophers.
Archaeologists uncovered the remains of a classical <w>gymnasium</w> near the edge of the city.
